title: Evaluating Text-based Conversational Agents for Mental Health: A Systematic Review of Metrics, Methods and Usage Contexts

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic review of evaluation scales used in existing literature, identifying a heavy reliance on Western-developed instruments that lack cultural adaptation for non-Western populations.
Critique of current evaluation methods, highlighting that the widespread dependence on self-reported scales makes the assessments vulnerable to social desirability bias.
